stages.purpose: Classify the current change scope for analyze-only or local-review-prep `/ai-change` usage.
Open a local ai-change run, create or reuse the branch for that run, and persist any explicit acceptance-source, acceptance-mode, and scope metadata that later review stages must import.

Run the bounded ai-change coding loop inside one session: implement one coherent phase, checkpoint it, force a local review pass for that phase-complete branch state, ingest reviewer context, and only then decide whether to stop or begin the next implementation phase without opening a separate transport surface.
Commit a staged checkpoint to the run branch and refresh the local review artifacts from the full branch diff.
Generate the local governance summary, selected checks, reviewer guidance, imported acceptance inventory, and scoped/strict acceptance gates that accompany the branch-local review pass.

Refresh the local branch-diff review packet into deterministic artifacts, preserve or update the current local review verdict for the reviewed branch state, record machine-readable scoped/strict acceptance evidence when required, and block approval persistence when any scoped/strict required acceptance evidence is missing or failing or when a required independent AI review artifact is missing, stale, self-authored, or incomplete for the reviewed head commit while retaining unscoped imported bullets as context inventory.
Require a clean worktree, refresh the local review artifacts, and mark the branch ready for local review.

Launch a separate AI code-review session from a clean worktree for the ready branch state, fail closed if the reviewer mutates tracked paths, unapproved untracked paths, or ignored run-state files other than the review artifacts, and persist an independent review artifact tied to the reviewed head commit, including known distinct implementer/reviewer identity/session values, finding counts, contract-sufficiency assessment, overfitting assessment, policy-substitution assessment, and derived-project high-risk audit answers when required.
Review the current branch diff locally from the review bundle and report findings in-session; this is the default approval boundary for state-changing work.
Block direct pushes to the protected branch from local clones when server-side branch protection is unavailable on the private repo.
outputs: Rejected direct push attempt to main

stages.purpose: Show the active git/local-review run status without reopening unrelated change context.

scripts.purpose: Classify change scope, enforce git/local-review governance checks, write review artifacts, and surface active run status.

functions.purpose: Classify a path-scoped change, choose the default local review posture, and attach any needed domain-specific deterministic checks, acceptance inventory, and scoped/strict acceptance gates.
Create a git/local-review ai-change run manifest, including any explicit acceptance-source, acceptance-mode, and scope metadata that should flow into later review artifacts.

Create an autopilot ai-change run manifest so the chat-owned session can iterate on coding, checkpoints, and local review feedback without the user manually sequencing each subcommand, while preserving any explicit acceptance-source, acceptance-mode, and scope metadata for later review gates.
Commit a run checkpoint from staged or explicit-path changes, then refresh the review bundle for the branch.

Write the local governance summary and machine-readable review manifest for a git branch change set, including the reviewed head-commit identity, imported acceptance inventory, scoped/strict acceptance requirements, and any named scoped required evidence artifacts that later review must judge against the same branch state; the command name remains a compatibility alias.
Launch a separate AI code-review provider session and write independent review JSON/Markdown artifacts for the reviewed head commit.

Refresh the latest local branch-diff review packet into feedback artifacts for the current run, while preserving or updating the machine-readable verdict for the same reviewed head commit, recording machine-readable scoped/strict acceptance evidence, and blocking `approved` / `approved_with_advisories` persistence when any scoped/strict required acceptance evidence is `missing` or `fail` or when required independent AI review validation fails.
Refresh review artifacts for the run branch and mark that branch ready for local review.

scripts.purpose: Block direct edits outside a real git repository so ai-change cannot silently bypass branch-local review transport.
Reject direct pushes to the protected branch from local clones unless an explicit emergency bypass is set.

prompts.purpose: Instruct the separate AI reviewer to inspect the branch diff, report concrete findings, and explicitly challenge contract sufficiency, overfitting, policy substitutions, and derived-project high-risk audit obligations.
